records.title: AIDA, Muscat, Oman
records.text: AIDA is a coastal hilltop master-planned community in Muscat, Oman. DarGlobal describes villas and branded residences, Trump International Golf Club Oman, community and retail centre, plazas, cafes and restaurants. DarGlobal says the site sits over 100 metres above sea level and about 10 minutes from downtown Muscat. Public descriptions include a Trump-branded golf course and residential and hospitality offerings. Availability and current pricing are not stated in this snapshot.

records.title: Trump Organization partnership portfolio
records.text: DarGlobal's Trump Organization collaborations include AIDA in Muscat, Oman (hotel, golf villas and cliff villas), Trump Tower Jeddah in Saudi Arabia, and Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai. AIDA is described as about 10 minutes from downtown Muscat. The developer page describes Trump International Oman as a 140-key five-star hotel complex at AIDA.

records.title: Trump International Oman at AIDA
records.text: DarGlobal announced Trump International Oman at its AIDA project. Public company materials describe it as a hotel and hospitality project within the coastal AIDA development in Muscat. Project timelines, prices and availability can change; confirm directly with DarGlobal.

records.title: D-Villas at Jumeirah Golf Estates
records.text: DarGlobal's FY25 results update describes D-Villas as a residential development within Jumeirah Golf Estates, an established master community in Dubai. Refer to the developer for current specifications and availability.

records.title: Wasalt Saudi Arabia property marketplace
records.text: Wasalt is a Saudi real estate services platform for discovering properties, connecting with property professionals, and finding opportunities across Saudi Arabia. The site offers listings for sale and rent, auctions, projects and property matching. Its home page identifies villas and apartments for sale in cities including Riyadh, Jeddah, Makkah and Madinah.

records.title: Saudi properties for sale (live listing snapshot)
records.text: The page showed 70,948 sale listings when checked on 2026-11-18. Examples shown included an apartment in Al Bawadi, North Jeddah at SAR 280,000 with 2 bedrooms; an apartment in Al Safa, North Jeddah at SAR 349,000 with 3 bedrooms; a floor in Ar-Rimal, East Riyadh at SAR 770,000 and 132 sqm; an apartment project in Riyadh (Mashid 10/Qurtubah) from SAR 1.06 million; and Sadeem Town Villa in Riyadh from SAR 2.29 million. These are time-sensitive examples, not guaranteed current listings.

records.title: Riyadh villas for sale (live listing snapshot)
records.text: The Wasalt Riyadh villas page showed 10,369 results when checked on 2026-11-18. Examples included a 228 sqm villa in Al-Muhammadiyah for SAR 4.69 million; a 300 sqm villa in Al-Muhammadiyah for SAR 3.8 million; a 199.54 sqm villa in Ar-Rimal for SAR 900,000; and a 312 sqm villa in Al-Maizaliyah for SAR 2.2 million. Listings and prices change frequently; consult the linked page for current details.

records.title: Riyadh rentals (live listing snapshot)
records.text: The Wasalt Riyadh rentals page showed 20,877 results when checked on 2026-11-18. Examples included a one-bedroom apartment in Al-Yarmuk for SAR 3,500 monthly, a two-bedroom apartment in As-Sahafa for SAR 85,000 yearly, and a six-bedroom 300 sqm villa in Al-Muhammadiyah for SAR 150,000 yearly. Rental listing values and availability change; check the live Wasalt page.

records.title: Free model router
records.text: The application uses OpenRouter's openrouter/free model router, which chooses among currently available free models. Free model access is rate limited and availability can vary. Requests require the operator to configure an OpenRouter API key as a server environment variable.
